ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses the microphone to record voice notes about your hands and for your stories and hand videos.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses Face ID to unlock the app, if you turn on the lock in Settings.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses the camera so you can photograph tax receipts and forms (W-2G, 1042-S) for your sessions and record your face for hand videos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sweatbook uses your photos so you can attach tax receipts and forms to your sessions.
